role: Recognises whether the live workout GPS track follows a route saved in SavedRouteStore, in forward or reverse direction, by mean nearest-neighbour fit of a sampled live track to a thinned prefix of the saved track.
types: RouteLibrary: enum (@MainActor) — namespace for route-matching constants and geometry
RouteLibrary.Match: struct — matched SavedRoute, rebuilt Route, direction, mean fit metres
toplevel: Only static constants; no stored mutable state. The start-point cheap reject (150 m) and prefix overshoot (+200 m) are inline magic numbers in scoreDirection.

flags.text: Reverse-direction matches rebuild the Route from CLLocation(latitude:longitude:) points that drop the saved altitude, so Route.fromGPX sees altitude 0 everywhere: the reversed Route has no climbs and zero ascent/descent. The comment says the reverse Route is built so the climb queue reflects climbs in this direction; in practice WorkoutRecorder binds a climb-less plannedRoute and computeUpcomingClimb never cues a climb on a reverse-run saved route.

units.does: Returns the best (lowest mean-fit) Match among the store's saved routes for `sport` (forward and reverse candidates), or nil if the sport is unsupported, the track has <2 points, the live track is shorter than 500 m, or no candidate fits within 30 m.

branches.effect: resolve AppDependencies.current.location.savedRouteStore (SavedRouteStore.shared unless overridden); else use the passed store

branches.cond: sport in supportedSports and track has >=2 points
for each saved route of this sport (newest first)
for each candidate whose fit beats the current best

branches.effect: ?? uses +infinity when no best yet so the first candidate always wins; ties keep the earlier (newer route, forward before reverse)

flags.text: No test calls RouteLibrary.findMatch, scoreDirection, candidates, evenSample or thinned (grep of EmuquTests finds none; RouteLibraryGeometryTests covers only trackPrefix/meanNearestDistance/nearestDistance), so the reverse-direction climb loss at :98/:108 and the 150 m start gate are unverified.

units.does: Converts a SavedRoute to a Route, builds a lat/lon-only CLLocation track from its trackpoints, and returns up to two Matches: forward against the saved Route and reverse against a Route rebuilt from the reversed track.

flags.text: Track rebuilt with CLLocation(latitude:longitude:) discards altitudeMeters, so the reverse Route built by Route.fromGPX has no climbs and 0 ascent/descent (forward keeps the original toRoute climbs).

Docs promise reverse-direction runs get the full climb queue with road names (FEATURES.md:50 'in either direction ... next 5 climbs ahead ... reverse-geocoded street name'; ARCHITECTURE.md:1330-1332 and FLOWCHART.md:1059-1061 'climb queue reflects the climbs the user will actually hit'). Code rebuilds the reverse Route from CLLocation(latitude:longitude:) (altitude 0) so it has no climbs, and even with altitude it would carry no enrichedClimbs road names because Route.fromGPX never sets roadName.

units.does: Scores one direction: rejects when either track is empty or the saved start is >150 m from the live start; otherwise takes the saved prefix of (live distance + 200 m), thinned to 5 m spacing, computes the mean nearest distance from up to 300 evenly sampled live points, and returns a Match when it is <=30 m.

live start within 150 m of saved start
branches.effect: continue; otherwise nil (route started mid-way is never recognised)

flags.text: Start-point gate (150 m) and prefix overshoot (+200 m) are unnamed magic numbers; a workout started mid-loop never matches.

branches.effect: subsample by index step track.count/count; otherwise return track as-is
